Name: Giant Bumblebees
Author: omena007
Description:
I really liked Eemie's bees but I wanted something bigger and calmer for myself so this mod was born. I was also inspired my Beorn's garden from the Hobbit books. This mod has been long in the making and I have made so many versions of it because I wasn't happy with the animation, speed etc. In the end I went with simple solutions. It adds Giant Bumblebees as custom critters that are spawn outside the farm[s] if you have any beehouses[/s] (apparently having beehouses is not a needed factor anymore?) .

Remember to put the mod in the Critters folder.
